job_description:
Artificial Intelligence Engineer
techstaff-in · Berlin, Germany (Hybrid)

About the job

Freelance Lead AI Engineer / AI Architect
Please note this role is solely for people who have a GmbH and freelance projects to refer to!

Rate: up to €115 per hour
Location: Berlin - 1-2 days onsite per week
Duration: 12 month contract

Overview

I’m supporting an AI transformation business that helps mid-market companies move from AI ideas and workshops into real working systems.

The challenge is simple: their clients want to use AI properly, but many do not yet have the architecture, data foundations or internal knowledge to make it scalable.

They need a Lead AI Engineer / AI Architect who can help turn business problems into production-ready AI solutions.

You’ll be working across:
AI solution architecture
Python / FastAPI development
LLMs, embeddings and automation workflows
Data pipelines and validation
Cloud-native deployment
MLOps, monitoring and engineering standards
Technical guidance for consultants, founders and engineers

Tech stack includes:
Python, FastAPI, SQL/NoSQL, LLM APIs, embeddings, AWS/Azure/GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, Airflow, Spark/PySpark, Git, CI/CD.

This would suit someone who enjoys being close to both architecture and hands-on delivery, especially in environments where AI needs to move beyond proof of concept and into production.

Experience with AI consulting, client-facing technical delivery, recommender systems, GenAI, data platforms or production ML would be highly relevant.

If you're an experienced Lead AI Engineer/Architect feel free to apply or send your resume to niall@techstaff-in.com

Freelance Lead AI Engineer / AI Architect
